news.title: Oracle says its contract with OpenAI is fully funded
news.description: Oracle said its contract with OpenAI was fully funded, in response to reports published in the media.

news.title: Cursor considers phasing out Chinese AI models
news.description: Cursor, a SpaceX subsidiary, told U.S. lawmakers that it was considering phasing out the use of Chinese AI models.

news.title: ChatGPT runs on a Super Nintendo console
news.description: Someone got ChatGPT running on a Super Nintendo, with performance considered better than expected.

news.title: OpenAI turns written briefs into playable 3D experiences with Astra
news.description: GPT-6.2 Astra can turn a written brief into an interactive browser experience, such as a playable pinball game or an explorable Colosseum. OpenAI says the model leads a human-evaluated 3D benchmark.

news.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT for Sales with ready-to-use sales workflows
news.description: ChatGPT for Sales offers workflows for selecting accounts, preparing calls and drafting follow-ups. The plugin also includes more than 30 partner integrations, including Canva and Gamma.

news.title: GTA VI generates $3.8 billion on its first day
news.description: Grand Theft Auto VI generated $3.79 billion in 24 hours, a record for a cultural release. Rockstar Games had sold 32.5 million copies even before launch.

news.title: YouTube nears $3 billion settlement with U.S. schools
news.description: YouTube is close to a settlement worth up to $3 billion with school districts accusing it of designing an addictive platform. The settlement would also include new protection measures, which have not yet been specified.

news.title: SEC investigates Nvidia’s accounting
news.description: The U.S. SEC has opened a civil investigation to determine whether Nvidia misled investors about its accounting, without currently accusing the company of breaking the law. The investigation focuses in part on its sales to Singapore and on a customer suspected of rerouting chips to China.

news.title: FBI investigates suspected intrusion into its criminal database
news.description: The FBI is investigating an apparent intrusion into the National Crime Information Center, used by U.S. law enforcement agencies to check warrants and conduct background checks. A former official said the reliability of the data could be called into question, beyond its confidentiality.

news.title: Trump threatens to tax data centers built overseas
news.description: Donald Trump said U.S. companies would be barred from building data centers overseas or would have to pay a very high tax. Alphabet, Amazon, Microsoft, Meta and Oracle already operate data centers in other countries.

news.title: Meta reconsiders its climate target as AI-related emissions rise
news.description: Meta is reassessing its pledge to reach carbon neutrality by 2030 after its emissions rose 45% in one year. Its total emissions increased from 15.6 million tons in 2024 to more than 21.7 million in 2025, partly due to its data centers and AI equipment.

news.title: Open Inkling 2 Mini model reasons in loops on a laptop
news.description: Inkling 2 Mini is a new open model that reasons in loops to solve problems with fewer words while running on a laptop.

news.title: Etsy abandons plans to use seller content to train AI
news.description: Etsy announced that it would not use seller content to train AI models after sellers opposed policy changes.

news.title: Neuralink participant pilots a GTA VI speedboat with his mind
news.description: A Neuralink trial participant piloted a speedboat in GTA VI using a brain implant during a new demonstration.

news.title: AI’s most misunderstood graph gets a major update
news.description: The graph considered the most misunderstood in AI has received a major update.

news.title: Researchers uncover a privacy flaw in the AI supply chain
news.description: A researcher placed 2 million canaries in the AI supply chain, revealing a serious privacy problem.

news.title: AI is not replacing jobs—it is turning them into precarious work
news.description: An article argues that AI does not necessarily eliminate jobs, but transforms them into outsourced, low-paid tasks.

news.title: SoftBank chief considered a $1 trillion takeover of SK Hynix
news.description: Masayoshi Son, SoftBank’s chief executive, considered a takeover of SK Hynix valued at $1 trillion, according to The Information.

news.title: Amazon tells defense teams to automate after China-linked intrusion
news.description: Amazon asked its defense teams to automate their processes after China-linked AI agents compromised a campus.

news.title: Google will shut down the Nest app and Google Assistant
news.description: Google plans to shut down the Nest app as well as Google Assistant.

news.title: Microsoft will retire its To Do apps next year
news.description: Microsoft plans to retire its To Do apps next year.

news.title: Corporate risk disclosures rarely cover AI’s real-world harms
news.description: Corporate risk disclosures cite the types of risks responsible for about 67% of technical failures, but only 2% of social harms such as bias.

news.title: Chatbots poorly detect distress signals revealed gradually
news.description: Tests show that chatbots detect distress signals when they are expressed in a single message, but miss them when they emerge gradually. Most models meet social workers’ standards in only 3% to 6% of these conversations.

news.title: AI news search engines reduce the diversity of Latin American sources
news.description: AI-powered news search tools provide fewer Latin American sources and less diversity than traditional search engines. They provide local users with 3.6 to 11.6 percentage points fewer national news stories.

news.title: Pre-election polls accurately measured public dissatisfaction
news.description: According to the Pew Research Center, polls correctly measured dissatisfaction with the national situation and strong Democratic motivation to vote. However, they underestimated the forces that brought Democrats back to power in Congress and in several states.

news.title: A Caltech math course captivates readers
news.description: In a Caltech introductory mathematics course, a professor explained that he no longer graded homework for accuracy because students use AI to complete it. Dozens of readers responded in the comments.

news.title: Gemini can now handle multistep everyday tasks
news.description: Google has expanded Gemini’s Tasks mode to perform tasks such as scheduling appointments, reviewing bills and placing grocery orders. The service asks for confirmation before certain critical steps, but Google recommends checking the results.

news.title: Google Maps generates complete itineraries for road trips
news.description: The new Ask Maps features create detailed plans, with day-by-day schedules and numbered stops, for excursions or multiday road trips. The itineraries show traffic, opening hours and the atmosphere of locations, among other details.

news.title: Claude Meetings joins Google Meet to create documents live
news.description: Anthropic launched Claude Meetings in beta, allowing users to add Claude to a Google Meet call to create documents and whiteboards live. Users must connect Google Calendar, select the meeting and add Claude.

news.title: The 50 Claude terms advanced users know
news.description: A glossary of 50 terms explains Claude’s key features and concepts, including artifacts, context windows, projects, skills and MCP. The article recommends immediately putting the terms one understands less well into practice.

news.title: Anthropic explains how Claude artifacts work
news.description: The guide introduces the documents, designs and small tools Claude creates in a panel beside the chat, as well as the options for editing and sharing them.

news.title: Claude explains the size of its context window
news.description: This article presents the limits of paid plans and explains how Claude summarizes older messages when a long conversation approaches the context limit.

news.title: Anthropic explains search across conversations and Claude’s memory
news.description: The guide shows how Claude remembers the user across conversations and how to view, edit or pause the information it retains.

news.title: The Model Context Protocol connects AI applications to data and tools
news.description: The Model Context Protocol is presented as an open standard for connecting AI applications to personal data and tools, like a USB-C port for AI.

news.title: Anthropic shows how to enable and create custom skills
news.description: The guide explains how to enable skills in the personalization settings and upload custom skills to automate tasks in Claude.
